articles.summary: Camden National Corporation (NASDAQ: CAC); ("Camden National" or the "Company") reported net income of $22.8 million and diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $1.34 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, resulting in a return on average assets of 1.31%, a return on average equity of 12.36%, and a return on average tangible equity (non‑GAAP) of 17.47%. "Our third-quarter results demonstrate continued momentum across the franchise, with year-over-year earnings growth, meaningful deposit growth, and strong credit performance," said Simon Griffiths, President and Chief Executive Officer of Camden National Corporation. "Strong deposit growth and continued customer acquisition improved our funding mix, reduced reliance on higher-cost borrowings, and expanded net interest margin by 15 basis points from the second quarter to 3.41%.
